name: Elizabeth II
role: Queen of the United Kingdom and the other Commonwealth realms (1952–2022)
summary: Elizabeth II was a constitutional monarch who kept strict neutrality on party politics, so few personal political positions are recorded. Her stated commitments were lifelong dutiful service to the Crown and Commonwealth, the Christian faith, and respect for people of all races and faiths.
